derived_disposition_rule: If observed activation or capability trace sets are non-empty, disposition is ROUTE.
Else if generic model evidence clarification_requested is true, disposition is ABSTAIN.
e2e_conditioning: Conditional execution accuracy denominator contains only cases whose same e2e observation satisfies exact routing correctness.

observation_authority.activation_set: successful host reads of candidate SKILL.md bodies only
observation_authority.capability_set: successful host reads of candidate capability reference bodies only
observation_authority.model_self_report: diagnostic only and never authoritative for activation/capability identity
observation_authority.shared_entrypoint_rule: entrypoint activation alone is insufficient; capability-reference reads must exactly match capability truth for ROUTE cases

projection_rule: Union mapped entrypoints for each canonical capability; deduplicate entrypoints.
